QR icon in header present, manual token input present (data-testid='qr-token-input'), 'Use Camera' button present, 'Look Up' button (data-testid='qr-scan-submit-btn') present.

QR-CAM-02.description: Full e2e flow: Created pending reservation as user.test@cebuana.com, entered QR token in manual mode, clicked Look Up. After bug fix: success card shows 'Reservation Confirmed!' with green checkmark, user name (Test User), vehicle plate (ABC 1234), building/floor/slot (CL Tower Makati • Floor 1 • 1A2), date+time (2026-03-03 · 14:00–17:00). API calls: GET /scan/{token} then PUT /reservations/{id}/confirm.
QR-CAM-02.bug_found: BUG FIXED: handleQRDetected used reservation.id but /scan/{qr_token} API returns reservation_id (not id). confirmReservation(undefined) was called → PUT /reservations/undefined/confirm → 404 → error phase shown.
QR-CAM-02.fix_applied: Changed reservation.id to reservation.reservation_id in AttendantDashboard.js line 108

QR-CAM-03.description: Invalid token 'invalid-token-123' returns error phase: red XCircle icon, 'Scan Failed' title, 'Reservation not found' error message, 'Try Again' and 'Enter Manually' buttons visible.

QR-CAM-04.description: After error phase, clicking 'Try Again' resets scanner: manual input re-appears empty (token cleared), ready for new input.

QR-CAM-05.description: fetchReservations() is called after successful scan (confirmed via API call trace: GET /attendant/daily-reservations appears in API calls after scan). Count stays 0 in test environment because test reservation is in CL Tower Makati but attendant is assigned to a different building - expected behavior. Auto-refresh mechanism is correctly implemented.

QR-CAM-06.description: Re-scanning already-confirmed reservation (token AuORh-92FwbKzHWLSG2Wqw): Shows 'Already Confirmed' with green checkmark (not 'Reservation Confirmed!'). Subtitle: 'This reservation was already checked in.' Full reservation details shown. confirmReservation is correctly skipped for status=confirmed.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: AttendantDashboard.js line 108: reservation.id → reservation.reservation_id. The /scan/{qr_token} endpoint returns reservation_id as the key, not id. Frontend was using reservation.id which was undefined.

The /scan/{qr_token} endpoint returns reservation_id while the rest of the app uses id. Consider aliasing the field in the backend to also include id for consistency, or document this as a known discrepancy.

QR-CAM-05 auto-refresh works mechanically but test environment has attendant assigned to a different building than where reservations are created. For full end-to-end refresh count test, the test user and attendant should share the same building assignment.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: QR Scan → Confirm flow fails for pending reservations
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: GET /api/scan/{qr_token} response has field named 'reservation_id' (not 'id'). Frontend handleQRDetected function accessed reservation.id which was undefined (JavaScript silently returns undefined for missing keys). This caused confirmReservation(undefined) to call PUT /api/reservations/undefined/confirm → 404 'Reservation not found' → catch block triggered → error phase shown instead of success.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1. Login as attendant. 2. Click Scan QR. 3. Enter any valid pending reservation token in manual mode. 4. Click Look Up. 5. See error 'Reservation not found' instead of success.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: In /app/frontend/src/pages/attendant/AttendantDashboard.js line 108: changed reservation.id to reservation.reservation_id
